record.title: Lott–Lück spectral-density optimality conjecture
record.statement: For every continuous computable function $g:\mathbb{R}_{+}\to\mathbb{R}_{+}$ such that $g(\varepsilon)\to 0$ as $\varepsilon\to 0$, there exist a group $G$ and a self-adjoint element $S\in\mathbb{Z}[G]$ such that, for some sequence of positive numbers $\varepsilon_i\to 0$, $$\mu_S((0,\varepsilon_i))>\frac{g(\varepsilon_i)}{|\log(\varepsilon_i)|}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/3](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13488), page 23. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Jacobi’s seven-cubes theorem

record.title: Szpiro’s discriminant conjecture for elliptic curves
record.statement:
Let $K$ be a number field. For every $\epsilon>0$, there exists a constant $C(K,\epsilon)$ such that every elliptic curve $E/K$ with conductor $N(E)$ satisfies

$$N_{K/\mathbb{Q}}\bigl(\Delta(E)\bigr)\le C(K,\u0000epsilon)\,N_{K/\mathbb{Q}}\bigl(N(E)\bigr)^{6+\u0000epsilon}.$$

Here $\Delta(E)$ denotes the minimal discriminant and $N(E)$ the conductor, as in the report.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13853), page 19. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rational points on the curves $C_p: 5y^2=4x^p+1$
record.statement: Let $p$ be an odd prime. If $p\le 19$, or, assuming GRH, if $p\le 53$, then the only rational points on $C_p: 5y^2=4x^p+1$ are $\infty$, $(1,1)$, and $(1,-1)$.

\[
\limsup_{t\to\pm\infty}\|q(t)\|=+\infty
\quad\text{and}\quad
\liminf_{t\to\pm\infty}\|q(t)\|<+\infty.
\]

record.title: Core points of non-2-homogeneous transitive permutation groups
record.statement: Conjecture: For every transitive permutation group $\Gamma \leq S_n$ that is not 2-homogeneous, there exist infinitely many core points, up to integral translations of the fixed space. Here a core point is a vector $z\in\mathbb{Z}^n$ satisfying $\operatorname{conv}(\Gamma z)\cap\mathbb{Z}^n=\Gamma z$, and the fixed space is $\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n : \gamma x=x\text{ for all }\gamma\in\Gamma\}$.

record.title: Hardness of approximating unconditional convex bodies by projections of simplex sections
record.statement:
Let $n\le N$. There exists an $n$-dimensional unconditional convex body $B$ such that, for every $n$-dimensional convex body $K$ obtained as a projection of a section of an $N$-dimensional simplex,
\[
d(B,K)\ge c\,(n\log N)^{1/4}\,\log^{-1}(n\log N),
\]
where $c$ is an absolute positive constant.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/56](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13951), page 63. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Petty’s conjectured projection inequality
record.statement:
For every dimension $d\ge 3$, let $K$ be a convex body in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Define its projection body by $h_{\Pi K}(x)=\lvert K\mid x^\perp\rvert$ for $x\in S^{d-1}$, where $K\mid x^\perp$ is the orthogonal projection of $K$ onto $x^\perp$, and set
$$
P(K):=\frac{\lvert\Pi K\rvert}{\lvert K\rvert^{d-1}}.
$$
Conjecture: $P(K)$ is minimal if and only if $K$ is an ellipsoid.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2015/56](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/13951), page 71. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Measure-theoretic slicing inequality of Koldobsky
record.statement:
Does there exist an absolute constant $L_2$ such that, for every even measure $\$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with a positive density and every origin-symmetric convex body $K$ in $\mathbb{R}^d$, one has

$$\mu(K) \le L_2 \max_{\xi \in S^{d-1}} \mu(K \cap \xi^\perp)\,|K|^{1/d}?$$

record.title: Logarithmic Khintchine–Steinhaus inequality
record.statement:
Let $S_1,S_2,\\ldots$ be independent identically distributed Steinhaus random variables, uniformly distributed on the unit circle $S^1\\subset\\mathbb C$. For every $n$ and every $x=(x_j)_{j=1}^n\\in\\mathbb C^n$ with $\\lVert x\\rVert_2=1$, 
\[
\\mathbb E\\log\\left|\\frac{S_1+S_2}{\\sqrt 2}\\right|\\leq \\mathbb E\\log\\left|\\sum_{j=1}^n x_jS_j\\right|.
\]

record.title: Cycle maps for quiver Grassmannians

\[
\phi_i\colon A_i(\operatorname{Gr}_{\mathbf e}(M))\longrightarrow H_{2i}(\operatorname{Gr}_{\mathbf e}(M))
\]
is an isomorphism for all $i$.
